content_blocks.label: clause_1._Testamentary_Intent
content_blocks.text: I, Alberto D. Birch, of Sunshine City, State of Verano, declare this to be my Last Will and Testament.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Distribution_of_Estate
content_blocks.text: My entire estate, including all personal property, real property, and financial assets, shall be distributed according to the terms set forth herein.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Executor
content_blocks.text: Linda K. Rose is appointed as the Executor of my estate and shall have full power and authority to carry out the provisions of this Will.
